paragraphs: Grandpa lives in a small apartment with a big window. Today Tom and Lily go to see him. Pip goes with them. Grandpa opens the door. "Hello, Tom! Hello, Lily!" says Grandpa. His face is not happy and his nose is red. He sits in his big armchair. The living room is cold, and the window is open.

"Do you have a cold, Grandpa?" asks Lily. "Yes, I do," says Grandpa. Lily looks at Grandpa with sad eyes. "I want to sleep." Tom closes the window. Lily goes to the kitchen. She gets some water. "Here you are, Grandpa," she says. Tom puts a rug on Grandpa's feet. Pip sits next to the armchair and looks at Grandpa.

Grandpa drinks the water and holds Lily's hand. "Thank you, Lily," he says. "Thank you, Tom." "You are good friends to me." "Sleep well, Grandpa," says Lily. Grandpa smiles. Pip says, "Woof!" The children say goodbye. Then they go home with Pip.
text.summary: Grandpa has a cold. Tom and Lily visit his apartment, bring him water, and put a rug on his feet.
